lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters; primary mid-flank section exhibits approximately 4 to 5 spots per vertical column with decreasing size towards the anterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a structural grid pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp light-to-shadow transition gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, lower-intensity high-luminance blobs localized primarily on the lower half of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable notch and irregular truncation on the posterior/trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; minor raggedness visible on the posterior margin of the upper caudal lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated dark silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral-lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.
